description: This file defines the GestureTrailTheme class, which manages visual theming for gesture trails in the gesture typing feature of the application. It includes methods for creating theme instances from style resources, calculating stroke sizes and colors for trail elements, and handling theme attribute parsing.

classes.name: GestureTrailTheme
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the visual theming parameters for gesture trails, including colors, stroke sizes, and trail length.

methods.name: GestureTrailTheme
methods.description: Constructor initializing the theme with specific colors, stroke sizes, and maximum trail length.

methods.name: fromThemeResource
methods.description: Static method to create a GestureTrailTheme instance from style resources and theme attributes.

methods.name: shiftColor
methods.description: Private static helper method to interpolate between two color component values based on a fraction.

methods.name: strokeSizeFor
methods.description: Calculates the stroke size for a trail element based on its index.

methods.name: strokeColorFor
methods.description: Calculates the color for a trail element based on its index, blending start and end colors.
